How to write to a parish in Poland when you don't speak Polish:

🔹 Keep it short and polite. One request per email.
🔹 Give what you know: the name, the approximate birth year, the parents' names, the village.
🔹 Ask if the book survives and where it is kept today. Many old books are now in diocesan archives.
🔹 Offer to cover the cost or make an offering.
🔹 Keep a log: who you wrote to, when, and what they answered.

Not every office replies. That's normal. Wait three or four weeks, then try the next address.

Find Your Polish Village in 30 Days includes ready-made emails in Polish with English beside them.
